name: Maell Lee
bio: Maell Lee is a highly popular Indonesian YouTuber, internet celebrity, actor, and singer. He catapulted to fame by creating high-energy slapstick comedy videos where he plays an aggressive, stunt-performing thug character who claims to be the "Preman Terkuat di Bumi" (The Strongest Thug on Earth)

credits.title: Maju Serem Mundur Horor
credits.overview: To satisfy their graduation requirements, four multi-ethnic film students collaborate on a low-budget horror film, only for their academic ambitions to be hijacked by authentic supernatural phenomena, severe demonic possessions, and mounting domestic crises on set.

credits.title: Anak Medan: Cocok Ko Rasa!?
credits.overview: The story of the friendship of four young men namely Ucok, Rafly, Joko and Chisa. Due to an incident, those who originally wanted to achieve their dreams together are far from each other.
